title: Compiler messages: pass-through and overlap with our rules
summary: Every Delphi compiler message (hint, warning, error) is stored per project and passed through to the editor under its own code; our rules that cover the same ground stay, and the docs state where each goes beyond the message
intro: Read this to see how compiler messages reach you and how they relate to drag-lint's own rules. Run a build through refresh-findings or the run_compile_check tool; the messages are stored with their codes, listed by query hints and published to the editor with source dcc. A rule such as unused-local or used-before-assignment overlaps a compiler message and stays, because it runs without a build and goes further in places; the wiki page says where.
